name: connectwise-control-mcp
description: Manage ConnectWise Control (ScreenConnect) remote support and access sessions from the terminal or your AI agent: list and inspect sessions across groups, run commands on guest machines, rename and tag sessions, manage instance users, and query the audit log - the whole instance from one CLI.

connectwise_control_base_url.title: CONNECTWISE_CONTROL_BASE_URL
connectwise_control_base_url.description: Your ConnectWise Control / ScreenConnect instance base URL, e.g. https://company.screenconnect.com (per-instance, required).

connectwise_control_username.title: CONNECTWISE_CONTROL_USERNAME
connectwise_control_username.description: Your ConnectWise Control instance user name (HTTP Basic auth).

connectwise_control_password.title: CONNECTWISE_CONTROL_PASSWORD
connectwise_control_password.description: Your ConnectWise Control instance password (HTTP Basic auth).

connectwise_control_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
connectwise_control_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on ConnectWise Control requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

connectwise_control_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
connectwise_control_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

connectwise_control_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
connectwise_control_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

connectwise_control_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
connectwise_control_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (32 characters or more). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
